terra.problem: The passage says the people were astonished, but it does not say nobody got upset.
The watch joke puts a modern object into the synagogue scene instead of keeping the comparison separate from the Bible setting.
Another question comes between the quoted question and the title, so he does not say the title right after that question. Calling Nazareth His hometown also needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage does not say the room gets loud or that nobody stays quiet. It says the people began asking one another.
The passage does not say the people were too busy to praise or that praise would come later.
The passage does not say who passed the news along or that it spread through the region within that Sabbath.
The passage does not say the news spread through Galilee in one Sabbath morning.
Promptly does not establish the exact timing claimed: no delay of even a few hours and as soon as they got to the house.
The passage does not say the house was full of guests.
The passage says the town gathered at the door that evening, not that they remained there through the night.
The passage does not say Jesus was still in the solitary place when they found Him.
The passage does not specify the direction Jesus went or say He did not return to Capernaum.
